title: SPM Bahasa Melayu oral test starts today | The Star
text:
SPM Bahasa Melayu oral test starts today | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The Bahasa Melayu Oral Test for the Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) 2023 examination starts on Monday (Jan 8), involving 395,870 registered candidates.
The tests are being conducted at 3,340 examination centres nationwide until Thursday (Jan 11).
